claim_type: DERIVED CONDITIONAL method bound under frozen action
state: One chosen balanced branch gauge/species-phase orbit; r>=1 finite; a,N>0; 0<epsilon<=1/100000
metric: Unnormalized Frobenius links and electric fields; real round spheres on q=psi/sqrt(N),w=bar(chi)/sqrt(N); minimize distance over gauge/species phases
automatic_acceptance: Initial metric distance <=delta gives energy excess <=B/2 and traps all time at distance <R
energy_acceptance: Initial metric distance <R AND energy excess <B traps all time at distance <R
target_variant: For 0<eta<=R replace B by m*eta^2/2 and delta^2 by eta^2*m/(2*J)
conservation_assumptions: Gauss-zero condition invariant; estimate holds before imposing it
excluded: perturbed or dissipative dynamics without new analysis
physical seconds, laboratory amplitudes or calibrated energy units
maximal basin or sharp saddle barrier
calculator: barrier_budget.py returns exact rational energy/radius bounds, exact delta^2 and certified rational lower/upper square-root bounds
